title: China Stock Market Jumps 4% as Beijing Pledges Support
summary: China's CSI 300 posted its best day in over two years, up more than 4%, after the State Council pledged new capital market support policies.
body_markdown:
Other Asia-Pacific markets also closed higher. South Korea's Kospi gained 4.34% to 4,915.68 and the Kosdaq jumped 8.13% to 708.99, while Japan's Nikkei 225 rose 2.11% to 58,711.11 and Australia's S&P/ASX 200 rose 0.80% to 8,833.6, per[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/26/stock-market-today-live-updates.html) .


The pledge landed on the same day as stronger factory data. Profits at sizeable industrial firms rose 20.1% in October from a year earlier, their fastest pace since May, according to China's National Bureau of Statistics, as reported by[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/27/china-industrial-profits-october.html) . Electronics makers' earnings doubled in the first 10 months as demand for AI computing power lifted memory chips, NBS chief statistician Yu Weining said, and high-tech manufacturing profits jumped 50.9%.


Not every economist sees a broad turnaround yet. Tianchen Xu, senior economist at the Economist Intelligence Unit, told[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/27/china-industrial-profits-october.html) that "the recovery has yet to broaden into a more durable improvement in corporate profitability."


In the US, S&P 500 futures were up 1.8% and Nasdaq-100 futures advanced 2.89% early Friday, ahead of a shortened session that closes at 1 p.m. ET, according to[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/26/stock-market-today-live-updates.html) .


## What Does Beijing's Support Pledge Do?


It commits China's cabinet to plan new incremental policies for the capital markets, including pushing listed companies to increase[dividends](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/what-is-dividends/) and share buybacks and further improving market stabilization, according to the official Xinhua news agency, as reported by[Reuters](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/china-to-strengthen-defense-against-imported-risks-in-capital-markets-5053016) . Reuters said the cabinet met on Friday morning.


The State Council executive meeting, chaired by Premier Li Qiang, also called for strengthening the market-stabilizing role of the "national team," further optimizing the quasi-stabilization fund function of Central Huijin and providing sufficient liquidity support, according to the[Hong Kong Economic Journal](https://longbridge.com/en/news/306978879) . The same report said the meeting called for effectively implementing existing policies and promoting the stable and healthy development of the capital market.
